topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
response: The 45° scan range increases scan losses, affecting link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users. This results in higher required transmitter power or reduced sensitivity, impacting coverage and capacity.
